description: Fixed filter bank — twelve band-pass filters with a low-pass and a high-pass on the ends, at the band frequencies of the Moog 914

params.text: Attenuates the low-pass filter under the lowest band by as much as -60dB before the filters are mixed
Attenuates the band at that frequency by as much as -60dB before the filters are mixed
Attenuates the high-pass filter above the highest band by as much as -60dB before the filters are mixed
Shifts every band an octave either way; FCV is bipolar, attenuverted by the knob

inputs.text: The signal fed to every filter; the channels patched here set the module's polyphony
Shifts every band an octave either way; FCV is bipolar, attenuverted by the knob

outputs.text: The odd-numbered bands mixed with the low-pass and the high-pass
The even-numbered bands mixed with the low-pass and the high-pass
